text: The Auditor General’s 2024 Work Plan included an audit to assess the Toronto Transit Commission’s (TTC's) workforce planning and management processes. Workforce planning and management, including succession planning, are critical to ensure the TTC's non-union workforce meets its operational requirements to support providing public transit services to the City of Toronto. In 2024, the TTC had a total average workforce of 16,300 full-time employees, comprised of 12,300 unionized (75 per cent) and 4,000 non-unionized employees (25 per cent). The scope of this audit was on the TTC's non-union workforce. An audit may be done in the future on the TTC's unionized workforce and is currently included in the backlog listing of the Auditor General's 2025 Work Plan.
